text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the scheduled race-viewing day.
<chrname> and the other Umamusume
all boarded the bus and headed off to their destination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With all the students gone, a faint groaning sound could be heard from the quiet school building...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Uuuugh~.
Where did the Umamusume gooo~...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Starved of precious Umamusume,
I have become Agnes Zombie Digital!!
choice_data_list: Weren't the students supposed to have gone to spectate the race...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Digi-tan has been out sick with a cold for a few days now~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wanted to see my lovely Umamusume so much
that I powered through my cold and came anyway!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And yet there's nobody here... Goddammit!!
I'm such an idiot for forgetting to watch the race!
choice_data_list: Why don't you head home just to be safe?
We should still be able to join in now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Heh, hehehe…… That's true.
I won't be getting any supply just hanging around the academy anyway—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aha! That's it!! Do you have any super-emo,
heart-melting stories about your trainee girl!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Please grant Digi-tan some charity for making it all the way to school!
Nutrients for my parched soul, please!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not knowing if it qualified as "super emotional," I told them a story about <chrname> during training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, thanks for the fuel...! I'll regroup for today, but tomorrow for sure, I'm gonna shower those cute Umamusume with all my love!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
choice_data_list: It'll be fine as long as you file a tardy slip.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
HYOOOO!! Are you a god or something!?
Let's go right now, right this second!!
Full speed ahead to the paradise of our dreams, let's GOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since I was already involved, I processed Agnes Digital's tardiness paperwork and accompanied her to the venue as her chaperone.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hauauauaua...
Heaven was... right here all along...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Even with the same cast and the same venue,
no two performances are ever identical. And what's more――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The emotions you get from your oshi are totally different every time!
That's why a true fan attends every single performance...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And so, Digi-tan shall embark on a journey to find the best vantage point to appreciate the lovely Umamusume!
